place.name: Turuépano National Park
place.description: The Turuépano National Park (Spanish: Parque nacional Turuépano) Is a protected area with national park status in the South American country of Venezuela, located in the Benítez, Cajigal, Libertador and Mariño municipalities in the eastern part of Sucre State, north of the San Juan River and in front of the Gulf of Paria. The park protects part of the Orinoco Delta swamp forests ecoregion.
